question.question: Which city was Calvin at on October 3, 2023?

evidence_items.text:
- Apparently based in Boston: on 2023-04-20 he offered to show Calvin around town when he visits [S3T10].
- For Calvin's upcoming visit, mentioned the awesome music scene and named Paradise Rock, House of Blues, and Fenway Park; said he'll count himself in for the front row when Calvin is up onstage [S3T10].
- Shared a photo of a city skyline with a boat in the water (Calvin's reply indicates it's Boston); Calvin said Boston looks great and thanked him for the tips [S3T10][S3T11].
- Plans to take Calvin to his favorite spots in the city for food; Calvin proposed grabbing a bite together, and Dave agreed enthusiastically [S3T15][S3T16].
- Closed the 2023-04-20 conversation looking forward to showing Calvin "the amazing music and food" in Boston, saying "See you soon!" [S3T18].
- Also plans to show Calvin some cars when he comes to Boston (see ## Classic cars) [S3T12].

evidence_items.speaker: Calvin
evidence_items.text:
- Heading to Japan in April 2023 ("next month" as of 2023-03-23) [S1T9].
- Staying in "such a nice place" (cozy living room with couch, table, and TV in photo) that his agent found for him; grateful for it [S1T9][S1T11].
- Plans for the trip: explore the city, try different local cuisines, and perhaps collaborate with musicians in the area [S1T13].
- Will be in Japan for a few months, then off to Boston afterward [S1T15].
- Plans to visit the park with the lake that Dave recommended, since he has never been there [S1T17].

- Later in the 2023-05-03 conversation: agreed with Calvin that driving with the wind in your hair, and walking around to explore the sights and sounds of nature, are calming [S5T9]; when Calvin said his music is stuck ("creativity's frozen"), gave him the creative-block tip (see ## Music) and encouraged Calvin to keep pursuing his music and never give up [S5T10][S5T11][S5T13]; the two said goodbye and agreed to keep in touch, with Dave saying Calvin can let him know if he ever needs help [S5T14][S5T15].
- On 2023-05-16, reconnected with Calvin ("long time no chat"); when Calvin shared that his place had flooded, Dave expressed sympathy, said the saved music gear and mic were "the important things", told Calvin to stay positive, and offered to help [S6T3][S6T4]; Dave praised Calvin's home music studio photo — "That studio looks awesome" — and said he hopes Calvin gets it fixed soon so he can keep creating [S6T5][S6T6]; when Calvin asked what he's working on, Dave excitedly told him about the shop's opening celebration (details in ## Car maintenance shop), and Calvin said he can't wait to get back to making music [S6T7][S6T8].
- The 2023-05-16 exchange continued: Calvin congratulated Dave on the shop (see ## Car maintenance shop), and when Dave asked about Calvin's music, Calvin shared the upcoming Tokyo performance [S6T10][S6T11]; Dave said doing a show in Tokyo is "wow", was sure the audience would love it, and wished him luck — Calvin promised to keep him posted on how it goes [S6T12][S6T13]; when Calvin shared a photo of the Tokyo night skyline (taken 2023-05-15), Dave called it a great shot, said the night skyline "really pops with those city lights," and said he has to take a trip to Tokyo soon [S6T14][S6T15][S6T16]; after Calvin said the city lights in Tokyo are amazing and encouraged him to visit, Dave said he is "definitely adding it to [his] list" and thanked Calvin [S6T17][S6T18].
- The 2023-06-09 conversation continued: Calvin asked what was new and exciting for Dave, and Dave announced he booked a trip to a mountainous region for next month (July 2023) — "finally gonna be able to see those majestic peaks" (details in ## Mountain trip (July 2023)) [S8T10]. Calvin said he wants to go on a hike in the mountains to escape it all and de-stress — see /memories/calvin.md > ## Mountains and hiking [S8T9]. The two exchanged trip wishes and signed off "see you soon" [S8T11][S8T12][S8T13][S8T14].
- On 2023-06-21, Calvin told Dave about a car accident he had on 2023-06-16 (no one hurt); Dave expressed sympathy, asked whether the insurance process had any issues and how long it took to sort out, and asked about the mechanic in Calvin's garage photo. Details of the accident and repair are in /memories/calvin.md > ## Car accident (2023-06-16) [S9T2][S9T4][S9T6][S9T8].

- On 2023-11-17, after Calvin closed the nature-photo exchange with a photo he shot in a Japanese garden (a bench under a tree with pink flowers), Dave: "Cool, Calvin! Found an even better spot, with a bench under a tree with pink flowers - so peaceful. A perfect spot to relax and take in the beauty." — describing the same bench-under-a-pink-flower-tree scene as "a spot" he found, and Calvin: "That sounds great, Dave! Can't wait to see it." [S30T17][S30T18]; Dave then shared it — "Check it out, Calvin. It's really calming, I think you'll like it." — and the two agreed "We will definitely go there!" (a plan to visit the spot together; if it is the same Japanese-garden scene Calvin photographed, the two have found a shared favorite, though Calvin's photo is the only image attached to it so far) [S30T19].
- On 2023-10-29, told Calvin he's been getting into photography recently — he's "seen some amazing places and taken some great shots" — and offered to show Calvin them (Calvin: "Yeah, show me what you got!") [S27T2][S27T3].
- Shared two Boston photos with Calvin on 2023-10-29: first, a photo of a city skyline at sunset with a clock tower — "Look at this magnificent sunset I captured on camera. It's truly breathtaking to witness such beautiful sunsets! The sky looks like it's on fire!" (Calvin: "Wow, that view looks awesome!") [S27T4][S27T5]; second, a photo of the clock tower in the city with buildings around it, which he took last month (~September 2023) — "got a great shot - it was stunning!" (Calvin: "Wow, that pic is amazing!") [S27T6].
- When Calvin recognized the clock tower ("In your last photo, is that the clock tower?"), Dave confirmed it is the clock tower — he snapped it at sunset and the colors were stunning [S27T7][S27T8].
- On 2023-10-29, said photography helps him capture and appreciate the beauty of nature — "It's been an awesome creative outlet and I'm loving it." (his appreciation of nature echoes his park walks — see ## Parks; Calvin: "You're so talented, Dave!", to which Dave said "Thanks, Calvin! Your kind words mean a lot.") (Calvin's side in the Music and Relationships sections of /memories/calvin.md) [S27T8].

- On 2023-09-15, told Calvin it's "been awesome": "Been restoring this vintage beauty" and shared the "final result" photo — a man standing next to a classic car — implying the restoration he had been updating Calvin on since 2023-08-14 (above) is now finished, ahead of his earlier hope (stated 2023-08-14) to have it done by the end of September 2023; Calvin: "Nice work, Dave! That looks amazing. Is it satisfying to see your hard work pay off?" [S19T7][S19T8]; Dave: "It's so satisfying to see this brought back to life," especially seeing people's reactions when they see the finished product — "makes all the hard work worth it" [S19T9].
- On 2023-09-22, reported a setback on the vintage Mustang (the restoration car he had been updating Calvin on — see above; he had shown the "final result" on 2023-09-15): he had been working on the engine and thought he'd fixed it, but when he started the car up he heard a weird noise — "So disappointing after putting so much work in"; shared a photo of the engine (a car engine with a small engine) and asked Calvin "Take a look at the engine!" [S20T1].
- On 2023-10-04, told Calvin he's been working on the Ford Mustang he found in a junkyard (the restoration car he has been updating Calvin on, see above) — "it was in bad shape, but I knew it had potential"; he said working on cars really helps him relax — "it's therapeutic to see them come back to life" — answering Calvin's question about what hobbies help him relax [S21T4].
- On 2023-10-04, after Calvin asked for pictures of the restoration looking amazing ("I'd love to see how it turned out!"), shared a photo of a red car parked in a field with other cars — "I put in a lot of work restoring it, but the result is awesome. It's so satisfying to bring an old car back to life." [S21T5][S21T6].
- On 2023-10-04, shared a photo of his own hands after a day in the garage — "permanently stained with grease. But it's worth it when you see the end result." [S21T8].

- Childhood song: one song "always makes [him] smile" — it played during a road trip with his dad, and they "had so much fun singing along to it"; on 2023-09-22, when Dave asked the name of the song, Calvin: "We used to rock a song by Tupac and Dr. Dre called 'California Love.' Ah, those were the days!"; Dave called the song a classic and invited Calvin to jam some music together, and Calvin agreed ("Yeah, let's do it! That would be awesome.") — the two are looking forward to an awesome jam session and creating something special (conversation flow in the 2023-09-22 entry of ## Relationships) [S20T6][S20T8][S20T9][S20T10][S20T16].
- On 2023-10-04, told Dave he met with some "incredible" artists in Boston the day before (2023-10-03) and talked about working together — the meeting was arranged through a mutual friend ("knew we'd be a great fit"); he found it "inspiring and exciting" because each artist has an individual style, and he's "stoked to collaborate with them on new music"; when Dave asked about it and to let him know how it goes, Calvin: "Can't wait to show you the final result." [S21T1][S21T2][S21T3].
- On 2023-10-04, when Dave asked what he works on to relax, Calvin shared a photo of a shiny orange car with its hood open and said he loves working on this project "to chill out" (a car project Calvin is working on himself — distinct from his own Ferrari, see ## New luxury car (Ferrari, 2023-03-26); makes sense given his long-standing finding that working on/fixing cars relaxes him "like meditation," see the 2023-05-31 entry in ## Relationships) [S21T3].
- On 2023-10-15, when Dave (feeling discouraged after his shop lost a deal to a competitor) asked how he stays motivated when faced with setbacks: "When setbacks come my way, I remind myself why I'm passionate about my goals. I rely on helpful people around me and take a break to recharge with my favorite activities. That always helps me get back to feeling motivated." (complements his earlier 2023-07-21 answer about staying motivated, see above) [S23T3][S23T4].
- On 2023-10-15, said performing with Frank Ocean "recently has been really cool" — said while reacting to Dave's music-festival story (see ## Relationships); the Frank Ocean tour he described to Dave on 2023-08-14 as having ended with the Tokyo show predates this remark, which suggests more recent performing with Frank Ocean (details in ## Frank Ocean collaboration; confirmed on 2023-10-19, when he told Dave he has started touring with Frank Ocean — see ## Frank Ocean collaboration) [S23T10].

evidence_items.section: # Dave > ## Hobbies and sense of purpose
evidence_items.text:
- Shared a photo from that time: a man and a child (Dave and his dad) posing for a picture — "a wonderful experience" [S12T6].
- On 2023-09-15, told Calvin (answering whether it's satisfying to see his hard work pay off, on the restoration finished that day — context in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)) that "It's so satisfying to see this brought back to life," especially seeing people's reactions when they see the finished product — "makes all the hard work worth it" [S19T9].
- On 2023-10-04, said he loves being able to transform something old and beat-up into something beautiful, and that it's the small successes that make him feel proud and fulfilled (said to Calvin right after Calvin praised his grease-stained hands — "Those hands show you worked hard. You put in lots of effort. You should definitely be proud!" — context in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)) [S21T10].
- On 2023-10-08, when telling Calvin about his car show and restored/modified car (details in ## Classic cars), said working on cars "is not just a hobby, it's a passion" — it's "like therapy, a way to get away from everyday stress"; as a kid he'd spend hours in his dad's garage, tinkering with engines — "it was like my own sanctuary" (echoing his childhood memories of working on cars with his dad, see above); now he's "lucky enough to do this as a job, to take something broken and make it into something awesome" [S22T5].
- On 2023-10-08, said doing what he loves has been "my goal since I was a kid" and it's awesome that he's able to do it; restoring things can be tough but "the feeling of accomplishment it gives is great"; Calvin responded that bringing broken things back to life is "so satisfying," that working on cars "can be a real escape from reality" (he understands the feeling), and that "doing what you love for a living, that's the ultimate goal," adding "Keep going with it, it's really inspiring." [S22T5][S22T6][S22T7].
